profile.headline: Software Developer
profile.summary: Drawing on a unique background in both the Design and Information Technology fields, my passion is to deliver software that is well designed, attractive, fun, useful, clear, concise, efficient, responsive and forgiving.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
I am an independent application developer with an emphasis on building great Apple mobile and desktop software. I have over 10 years experience working with Xcode, Objective C, Cocoa Touch in addition to some limited experience with Cocoa development for MAC OS X. I have several successful iOS (iPhone/iPad) applications available for sale in the iTunes App Store with several more applications in various stages of development. I also regularly consult with other iOS developers and application owners on all phases of their projects. 

One of my iOS apps "Rain Harvest" was reviewed in the Spring 2013 edition of “The Herb Quarterly” magazine in an article entitled “The Best Gardening Apps” written by Vicky Uhland. 

Rain Harvest was again featured in 2016 in the article "7 Hot Garden Trends to Sync with Nature" at Fantastic Gardeners Blog -  http://blog.fantasticgardeners.co.uk/garden-trends-2016-sync-with-nature/.

I also have experience working with many other technologies (please see my LinkedIn skills list) including most aspects of web development, ASP, SQL, Xojo, VBA, VB, Excel customization.

positions.title: Technical Specialist/Scientist
positions.description:
Supported the Facilities Management Department, Site Support Services Division. My responsibilities included: 

SAP administration, SAP Maintenance Plan/Task (PM) administration, SAP departmental notifications backlog reduction, web development and administration, Acrobat and HTML forms development, maintenance and administration, AutoCAD support and customization using AutoLisp and Visual Basic, Microsoft Office automation and customization using Visual Basic (VBA), Microsoft Access database development and administration. Ad hoc report development using various report writing tools including Infomaker, Microsoft Access and Excel.

positions.title: Facilities Planner
positions.description: Contracted to Southern California Edison, SONGS, Facilities Planning Department. Extensive experience providing space planning and construction document preparation utilizing AutoCAD. Assumed the role of departmental CAD Manager while providing extensive AutoCAD support, training and customization utilizing AutoLisp and Visual Basic (VBA).

positions.title: Facilities Engineer
positions.description: Facilities Engineer at the Connecting Devices Division formerly located in Irvine, California. Extensive experience providing space planning and construction document preparation.

positions.title: Structural Designer
positions.description: Structural designer/detailer for large petrochemical engineering design firm.

projects.title: iOS App: Guard Passing Drills for 1360 Films
projects.description: Contracted by the app owner (1360 Films) to develop a new iOS app which showcases world-renowned teacher and competitor of Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu Leticia Ribeiro.

projects.title: OS App: Heel Hooks for 1360 Films
projects.description: Contracted by the app owner (1360 Films) to develop a new iOS app which showcases Brazilian mixed martial artist, Jiu-Jitsu Black Belt and UFC Bantamweight fighter Pedro Munhoz.
